title: Tutor Reply Hint Levels
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Classify eight AI tutor replies to the same juice-price question by hint level, from 1 (asks a question) to 4 (gives the answer).

learningObjectives: The learner will classify eight AI tutor replies to the same question by hint level (1 to 4), correctly placing at least seven of eight on the first attempt.
prerequisites: Productive struggle, the four-level hint ladder, cognitive offloading, and AI tutor, from Chapter 2 and Chapter 11

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, get feedback with the reason, and review what was missed
keyQuestions: What is left for the student to do after this reply?
Does this reply suit a first response?
commonMisconceptions: A reply that is polite and detailed is a good hint
A long explanation is a Level 1 hint
A hint that shows a worked example of the same problem is not giving the answer
assessmentOpportunities: "Divide the total by the number of bottles." Which level?
Is a worked example of a similar problem a Level 1 hint?
Why does a polite reply that states the answer still count as Level 4?

controls.name: Choice buttons
controls.description: commit an answer. A wrong first answer gives a hint and lets you choose again; only the first answer counts.

controls.name: Show definitions
controls.description: opens or closes the reference table. Reading it is exploration, not evidence.

controls.name: Next
controls.description: moves to the next item after feedback. On the results screen, Previous missed and Next missed step through what you missed.

controls.name: Play again
controls.description: starts a practice run with the items reshuffled. Practice runs do not change the first-run score.
